method: in-container COPY FROM PROGRAM (read-only); no host SSH
unattributed_breakdown: estimates only: containerd image layers/snapshots + other container volumes + container/system logs + OS dirs; requires admin checklist
reclaimable_confident: old images/exited containers/log truncation/package caches/core dumps ~30-120GB pending checklist
reclaimable_within_pgdata: none at host level; bloat handled via STORAGE-R1 REINDEX path (~57GB) not file deletion
